root_idea.summary: The root centers on one thing standing in place of another and on a corresponding return or recompense.
root_idea.development: This orientation extends to sufficiency and substitution, repayment and requital, reciprocal compensation, and payments made in lieu of something else.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The principal Form I Quranic verb, normalized to the Classical Arabic citation form جَزَى.
A distinct QAC Form III Quranic verb occurring at 34:17, normalized to جَازَى.
A Quranic active participle, normalized from the inflected form جَازٍ.
A distinct Quranic verbal noun and lexical noun, normalized to جَزَاء.
A distinct Quranic noun, normalized to جِزْيَة.

senses.definition: To repay, requite, recompense, or reward someone for an act or thing; in a negative context, to punish or requite with harm.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses active and passive forms for bestowing or receiving a corresponding recompense; the resulting recompense may be favorable or unfavorable according to the deed.

senses.definition: To suffice, avail, or make satisfaction for someone or something; to serve as a substitute or compensating equivalent.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially used with عَنْ to express satisfying or availing on behalf of another; the Quran uses the construction for one person or thing not availing another.

senses.definition: To recompense or requite, returning an outcome corresponding to an act.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence is an active imperfect Form III verb in a context of recompensing a people for their conduct.

senses.definition: Sufficing or availing; one who can stand in for or make satisfaction for another.
senses.usage_conditions: An active participle used with عَنْ in the sense of availing or satisfying on behalf of another.

senses.definition: A recompense or requital corresponding to an act: a reward for good or a punishment for evil.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the resulting return or due; its positive or negative value is determined by the context.

senses.definition: A payment or tax taken from protected non-Muslim subjects as part of the compact securing their protection.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic noun refers to the payment demanded from those subjects in the stated political and legal arrangement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pay a debt or a person's due, or to render something as satisfaction; hence, to satisfy or content.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a debt, right, or thing rendered as a due or satisfaction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stand or serve in place of another, even when the substitute does not fully suffice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical substitution use distinct from actually satisfying or availing the person for whom the substitute is provided.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something sufficient or to cause it to serve in place of another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV or dialectal usage reported for the جَزَى عَنْ construction; it is distinguished from the Tameem form أَجْزَأَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a benedictive formula, to ask God to reward someone or to say, “May God reward you.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression such as جَازَاهُ خَيْرًا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vie or contend with another in requiting or compensating, and to overcome him in that exchange.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or competitive Form III use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To furnish a knife with a handle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as a dialectal variant of أَجْزَأَ; its status is questioned in the lexical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To demand payment of a debt, or for two parties to repay or requite one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a debt and, in the reciprocal expression, for mutual repayment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or demand repayment, requital, compensation, or recompense from someone.
Metaphorically, a land tax or a tax paid by the owner of land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical Arabic extension of the noun beyond its Quranic reference to the jizyah imposed on protected subjects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The interval between a sneeze and the conventional blessing addressed to the sneezer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized expression concerning the timing of the response to a sneeze.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The apodosis or complement of a conditional statement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A grammatical term for the result or correlative clause of a condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A conditional particle, or the designation of a particle that marks the result or complement of a condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A grammatical use associated with conditional constructions.
Attested in the expression ذُو جَزَاءٍ, describing one possessing sufficiency or means.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sufficient for a load or burden, or sufficient for a person's affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a camel in the first use and to a man in the second; the lexical source identifies the printed forms as transcriptional errors for مُجْزٍ.

cautions: The Form III Quranic group is retained as a distinct public form because QAC identifies نُجَازِي at 34:17, despite a general lexical statement that the Quran uses جَزَى rather than جَازَى.
جَزَاء covers both favorable and unfavorable recompense; reward and punishment are contextual values of the same lexical notion rather than separate Quranic noun senses.
